s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic respiratory symptoms with progressive dyspnea, fatigue, and weight loss, following a viral infection, with pleuritic chest pain and imaging findings suggestive of a pulmonary infiltrative process
salient_findings: Progressive dyspnea and chronic cough after COVID-19 infection
Pleuritic chest pain and right-sided pneumothorax
Imaging findings of parenchymal abnormalities with ground-glass halo and central cavitation
key_facts: 43-year-old woman with mild intermittent asthma
Symptoms started 6 months before presentation
Dyspnea and chronic cough after resolution of COVID-19 infection
Progressive dyspnea, fatigue, anorexia, and weight loss
No improvement with steroid taper for asthma exacerbation
Worsening shortness of breath and new pleuritic chest pain 7 days before presentation
Afebrile and mildly tachypneic at presentation
Oxygen saturation of 91% on room air
Leukocyte count 7.1 × 10⁹/L with 71% neutrophils and 0.1% eosinophils
Aspergillus IgG >200 mg/L
A. niger IgE 1.04 kU/L (weakly positive)
HIV antibody negative
TB testing (interferon-gamma release assay) negative
Serum Aspergillus galactomannan index <0.5 (negative)
No immunoglobulin deficiency on quantitative serum immunoglobulin testing
